summary: The agent assisted the customer with linking Aadhaar.

intents.keywords: Hello, I want to know how to link my Aadhaar ... branch help me.

issues.issue: Difficulty linking Aadhaar to savings account.
issues.reason(s): Customer unable to get help at the branch and finds online processes confusing.

intents.actions of agent: The agent offered to guide the customer, provided alternative solutions (branch visit or online form), and offered to send the form to the customer's email.
intents.Process Request: Send a simple form to the customer's registered email.
intents.resolution: The agent will send a simple form to the customer's registered email address to facilitate Aadhaar linking.
